urn:solid:Accept.label: Accept
urn:solid:Accept.description: An indication that the actor accepts the object — typically a Follow request or invitation.

urn:solid:Action.label: Action
urn:solid:Action.description: An action performed by a direct agent on a direct object — schema.org's analogue of an activity.

urn:solid:Activity.label: Activity
urn:solid:Activity.description: An action taken by an actor — the base for Create, Like, Follow, Announce, etc.

urn:solid:Add.label: Add
urn:solid:Add.description: An activity in which the actor is adding the object to the target.

urn:solid:Agent.label: Agent
urn:solid:Agent.description: A thing that acts — person, organization, group, or software.

urn:solid:AnnotationProperty.label: AnnotationProperty
urn:solid:AnnotationProperty.description: An OWL property used purely for human-readable metadata — labels, comments, version notes — with no formal semantic implications.

urn:solid:Announce.label: Announce
urn:solid:Announce.description: An activity in which the actor is calling the audience's attention to the object — a boost or repost.

urn:solid:Answer.label: Answer
urn:solid:Answer.description: An answer to a Question — typically posted on Q&A sites or forums.

urn:solid:Append.label: Append
urn:solid:Append.description: The WAC Append access mode — permission to add new content to a resource without modifying existing content.

urn:solid:Application.label: Application
urn:solid:Application.description: An ActivityStreams actor representing a software application — a bot, service, or automated client.

urn:solid:Article.label: Article
urn:solid:Article.description: An article — a written work, typically published as part of a larger publication.

urn:solid:Association.label: Association
urn:solid:Association.description: A qualified PROV association — the role-aware participation of an Agent in an Activity.

urn:solid:Attribution.label: Attribution
urn:solid:Attribution.description: A qualified PROV attribution — the role-aware relation between an Entity and the Agent it is attributed to.

urn:solid:Audio.label: Audio
urn:solid:Audio.description: An audio resource — used in ActivityPub for audio attachments and stand-alone audio posts.

urn:solid:AudioObject.label: AudioObject
urn:solid:AudioObject.description: An audio file with structured metadata — duration, encoding, transcript.

urn:solid:Authorization.label: Authorization
urn:solid:Authorization.description: A Web Access Control (WAC) authorization — grants one or more access modes on a resource to one or more agents.

urn:solid:BasicContainer.label: BasicContainer
urn:solid:BasicContainer.description: An LDP Container whose membership is defined entirely by `ldp:contains` triples.

urn:solid:BibliographicResource.label: BibliographicResource
urn:solid:BibliographicResource.description: A book, article, or other documentary resource — typically with structured citation metadata.

urn:solid:Block.label: Block
urn:solid:Block.description: An indication that the actor is blocking the object — typically another actor.

urn:solid:BlogPosting.label: BlogPosting
urn:solid:BlogPosting.description: A single blog post — an entry in a weblog, typically with a date and an author.

urn:solid:Book.label: Book
urn:solid:Book.description: A book — a long-form written work, typically published as a single physical or digital volume.

urn:solid:Brand.label: Brand
urn:solid:Brand.description: A brand — a distinctive identity associated with a product, service, or organization.

urn:solid:Bundle.label: Bundle
urn:solid:Bundle.description: A named bundle of PROV provenance descriptions — a way to attribute provenance to provenance.

urn:solid:Catalog.label: Catalog
urn:solid:Catalog.description: A DCAT Catalog — a curated collection of metadata about Datasets and DataServices.

urn:solid:ChangeEvent.label: ChangeEvent
urn:solid:ChangeEvent.description: A reorganisation event in which one set of Organizations was transformed into another — a merger, split, rename, or restructuring.

urn:solid:ChatMessage.label: ChatMessage
urn:solid:ChatMessage.description: A chat message — a single message exchanged in a chat conversation.

urn:solid:City.label: City
urn:solid:City.description: A city — a permanent settlement of significant size.

urn:solid:Class.label: Class
urn:solid:Class.description: The class of RDF classes — the meta-class whose instances are themselves classes (Person, Note, Activity, etc.).

urn:solid:CollectionPage.label: CollectionPage
urn:solid:CollectionPage.description: A single page of an ActivityStreams Collection — a slice of the members, plus pagination links back to the parent and to neighbouring pages.

urn:solid:CollegeOrUniversity.label: CollegeOrUniversity
urn:solid:CollegeOrUniversity.description: A college, university, or other institution of higher education.

urn:solid:Comment.label: Comment
urn:solid:Comment.description: A comment on the parent CreativeWork — a reader's response or annotation.

urn:solid:Communication.label: Communication
urn:solid:Communication.description: A qualified PROV communication — the role-aware form of `wasInformedBy` between two Activities.

urn:solid:Concept.label: Concept
urn:solid:Concept.description: A SKOS concept — a unit of thought (topic, category, term) suitable for use in a controlled vocabulary or thesaurus.

urn:solid:ConceptScheme.label: ConceptScheme
urn:solid:ConceptScheme.description: A SKOS concept scheme — an aggregation of related Concepts, typically a thesaurus, taxonomy, or controlled vocabulary.

urn:solid:ContactPoint.label: ContactPoint
urn:solid:ContactPoint.description: A contact point for a person or organization — an aggregation of reachable contact channels for a specific purpose or department.

urn:solid:Container.label: Container
urn:solid:Container.description: A Linked Data Platform Container — an LDP resource that contains other resources, the LDP analogue of a directory.

urn:solid:Control.label: Control
urn:solid:Control.description: The WAC Control access mode — meta-permission to read and modify the Authorization (`.acl`) file itself.

urn:solid:Country.label: Country
urn:solid:Country.description: A country — a sovereign nation-state or territory.

urn:solid:Create.label: Create
urn:solid:Create.description: An activity in which the actor has created the object.

urn:solid:CreativeWork.label: CreativeWork
urn:solid:CreativeWork.description: The most generic kind of creative work — written, photographic, artistic, or otherwise.

urn:solid:DIDDocument.label: DIDDocument
urn:solid:DIDDocument.description: The descriptor for a Decentralized Identifier — carries the DID's verification keys, service endpoints, and controller relationships.

urn:solid:DataService.label: DataService
urn:solid:DataService.description: A DCAT DataService — a service that gives access to one or more Datasets via an API or query interface.

urn:solid:Dataset.label: Dataset
urn:solid:Dataset.description: A DCAT Dataset — a collection of data, published or curated by a single agent and available in one or more representations.

urn:solid:Datatype.label: Datatype
urn:solid:Datatype.description: The class of RDF datatypes — XSD types (`xsd:string`, `xsd:dateTime`, `xsd:integer`) and any custom datatypes defined for an RDF graph.

urn:solid:DatatypeProperty.label: DatatypeProperty
urn:solid:DatatypeProperty.description: An OWL property whose values are literals — strings, numbers, dates, booleans — never IRIs or blank nodes.

urn:solid:Delegation.label: Delegation
urn:solid:Delegation.description: A qualified PROV delegation — the role-aware form of `actedOnBehalfOf` between two Agents.

urn:solid:Delete.label: Delete
urn:solid:Delete.description: An activity in which the actor has deleted the object.

urn:solid:Derivation.label: Derivation
urn:solid:Derivation.description: A typed PROV derivation event — a relation between a derived entity and the entity it was derived from.

urn:solid:DigitalDocument.label: DigitalDocument
urn:solid:DigitalDocument.description: An electronic document — typically a file (PDF, spreadsheet, presentation, text file).

urn:solid:DirectContainer.label: DirectContainer
urn:solid:DirectContainer.description: An LDP Container that adds membership triples on a separate `membershipResource` rather than carrying them itself.

urn:solid:Distribution.label: Distribution
urn:solid:Distribution.description: A DCAT Distribution — a specific representation of a Dataset (a downloadable file or accessible API).

urn:solid:Document.label: Document
urn:solid:Document.description: A document of any kind — typically a web resource.

urn:solid:EducationalOrganization.label: EducationalOrganization
urn:solid:EducationalOrganization.description: An educational organization — a school, college, university, or training institute.

urn:solid:EmailMessage.label: EmailMessage
urn:solid:EmailMessage.description: An email message — represents a single sent or received email as RDF.

urn:solid:EmptyCollection.label: EmptyCollection
urn:solid:EmptyCollection.description: A PROV Collection with no members — the explicit empty case.

urn:solid:Entity.label: Entity
urn:solid:Entity.description: Anything in PROV that has provenance — a thing whose existence and history can be tracked.

urn:solid:Event.label: Event
urn:solid:Event.description: An event happening at a certain time and (often) location.

urn:solid:FAQPage.label: FAQPage
urn:solid:FAQPage.description: A web page that answers commonly-asked questions on a particular topic.

urn:solid:FileFormat.label: FileFormat
urn:solid:FileFormat.description: A digital file format — typically referenced as the type of a `dcterms:format` value.

urn:solid:Flag.label: Flag
urn:solid:Flag.description: An ActivityStreams Activity indicating that the actor is reporting the object as objectionable — the standard fediverse content-moderation primitive.

urn:solid:Follow.label: Follow
urn:solid:Follow.description: An indication that the actor wants to follow the object — typically another Actor.

urn:solid:FormalOrganization.label: FormalOrganization
urn:solid:FormalOrganization.description: An ORG FormalOrganization — an organization with legal recognition (company, government body, registered nonprofit).

urn:solid:Frequency.label: Frequency
urn:solid:Frequency.description: A rate at which something recurs — daily, weekly, monthly, etc.

urn:solid:FunctionalProperty.label: FunctionalProperty
urn:solid:FunctionalProperty.description: An OWL property that takes at most one value per subject — if `A p B` and `A p C`, then `B owl:sameAs C`.

urn:solid:Generation.label: Generation
urn:solid:Generation.description: A qualified PROV generation event — the moment an Activity produced an Entity.

urn:solid:GeoCoordinates.label: GeoCoordinates
urn:solid:GeoCoordinates.description: The geographic coordinates of a place — a latitude/longitude pair, optionally with elevation.

urn:solid:Group.label: Group
urn:solid:Group.description: A collection of agents — informal or ad-hoc, not necessarily a formal organization.

urn:solid:Hashtag.label: Hashtag
urn:solid:Hashtag.description: An ActivityStreams Link representing a hashtag — a topical keyword, conventionally prefixed with `#`, attached to an Object as a tag.

urn:solid:HowTo.label: HowTo
urn:solid:HowTo.description: Instructions for performing a task — a tutorial or how-to guide.

urn:solid:Ignore.label: Ignore
urn:solid:Ignore.description: An ActivityStreams Activity indicating that the actor is silently disregarding the object — a soft mute, distinct from Block.

urn:solid:Image.label: Image
urn:solid:Image.description: An image — a document that is a still picture (PNG, JPEG, SVG, etc.).

urn:solid:ImageObject.label: ImageObject
urn:solid:ImageObject.description: A rich image object — an image with structured metadata like dimensions, encoding, and caption.

urn:solid:IndirectContainer.label: IndirectContainer
urn:solid:IndirectContainer.description: An LDP Container whose membership triples reference an indirected member resource via `insertedContentRelation`.

urn:solid:Influence.label: Influence
urn:solid:Influence.description: PROV's most general qualified-relation superclass — any role-aware connection between an Activity, Entity, or Agent.

urn:solid:IntransitiveActivity.label: IntransitiveActivity
urn:solid:IntransitiveActivity.description: An ActivityStreams Activity that has no direct object — the actor performs the verb without acting upon a specific thing (Travel, Move, Arrive).

urn:solid:Invalidation.label: Invalidation
urn:solid:Invalidation.description: A qualified PROV invalidation event — the moment an Entity ceased to exist.

urn:solid:InverseFunctionalProperty.label: InverseFunctionalProperty
urn:solid:InverseFunctionalProperty.description: An OWL property whose value uniquely identifies the subject — if `A p X` and `B p X`, then `A owl:sameAs B`.

urn:solid:ItemList.label: ItemList
urn:solid:ItemList.description: An ordered list of items — schema.org's lightweight ordered collection for SEO-rich markup.

urn:solid:JobPosting.label: JobPosting
urn:solid:JobPosting.description: A listing for a job — an opportunity to be employed in a specific role.

urn:solid:Jurisdiction.label: Jurisdiction
urn:solid:Jurisdiction.description: A legal, political, or administrative jurisdiction — a country, state, or governing region.

urn:solid:LicenseDocument.label: LicenseDocument
urn:solid:LicenseDocument.description: A legal document giving permission to do something with a resource — typically referenced by the `license` predicate.

urn:solid:Like.label: Like
urn:solid:Like.description: An indication that the actor likes, recommends, or favorites the object.

urn:solid:LinguisticSystem.label: LinguisticSystem
urn:solid:LinguisticSystem.description: A system of communication including written, spoken, signed, or symbolic languages.

urn:solid:Link.label: Link
urn:solid:Link.description: An ActivityStreams Link — a typed, qualified pointer to a resource. Distinct from a plain URL string in that a Link can carry rel, hreflang, mediaType, dimensions, and a name.

urn:solid:ListItem.label: ListItem
urn:solid:ListItem.description: An entry in a schema.org ItemList — wraps the item with positional metadata.

urn:solid:Listen.label: Listen
urn:solid:Listen.description: An ActivityStreams Activity indicating that the actor listened to the object — typically audio content (a song, podcast episode, broadcast).

urn:solid:Logo.label: Logo
urn:solid:Logo.description: A vCard Logo resource — the logo image associated with a vCard (typically for an Organization).

urn:solid:MediaTypeOrExtent.label: MediaTypeOrExtent
urn:solid:MediaTypeOrExtent.description: A union class for `dcterms:MediaType` and `dcterms:SizeOrDuration` — the range of `dcterms:format`.

urn:solid:MemberSubject.label: MemberSubject
urn:solid:MemberSubject.description: An LDP marker class for the special predicate value used by IndirectContainers when membership is computed from the inserted resource itself.

urn:solid:Membership.label: Membership
urn:solid:Membership.description: An ORG Membership — a role-and-time-aware participation of an Agent in an Organization.

urn:solid:Mention.label: Mention
urn:solid:Mention.description: An ActivityStreams Link representing a mention of an Actor — typically authored as `@user@host` and attached to an Object so the mentioned party is notified.

urn:solid:Move.label: Move
urn:solid:Move.description: An activity in which the actor moves the object from one location (origin) to another (target).

urn:solid:Movie.label: Movie
urn:solid:Movie.description: A movie — a feature-length motion picture released as a single work.

urn:solid:MusicRecording.label: MusicRecording
urn:solid:MusicRecording.description: A music recording — a song or instrumental track in its recorded form.

urn:solid:NewsArticle.label: NewsArticle
urn:solid:NewsArticle.description: A news article — a journalistic article published as part of news media coverage.

urn:solid:NonRDFSource.label: NonRDFSource
urn:solid:NonRDFSource.description: An LDP Resource whose state is NOT RDF — typically a binary file like an image, audio, or PDF.

urn:solid:Note.label: Note
urn:solid:Note.description: A short written work — typically a microblog post, comment, or reply.

urn:solid:Notification.label: Notification
urn:solid:Notification.description: A Linked Data Notification — a message POSTed to an inbox to inform the receiver about something.

urn:solid:Object.label: Object
urn:solid:Object.description: The base class for all ActivityStreams objects — anything that can be the subject or target of an Activity.

urn:solid:ObjectProperty.label: ObjectProperty
urn:solid:ObjectProperty.description: An OWL property whose values are individuals (other resources, identified by IRI or blank node) — never literal strings, numbers, or dates.

urn:solid:Offer.label: Offer
urn:solid:Offer.description: An offer to transfer some rights to an item or to provide a service — typically a price for a Product.

urn:solid:OnlineAccount.label: OnlineAccount
urn:solid:OnlineAccount.description: An account held by an Agent on some online service.

urn:solid:OrderedCollection.label: OrderedCollection
urn:solid:OrderedCollection.description: An ordered collection of objects — most-recent-first by convention in ActivityPub.

urn:solid:OrderedCollectionPage.label: OrderedCollectionPage
urn:solid:OrderedCollectionPage.description: A single page of an ActivityStreams OrderedCollection — the ordered analogue of CollectionPage, with members in `as:orderedItems` rather than `as:items`.

urn:solid:Organization.label: Organization
urn:solid:Organization.description: A formal organization — a company, society, institution, or other collective with structure.

urn:solid:OrganizationalUnit.label: OrganizationalUnit
urn:solid:OrganizationalUnit.description: An ORG OrganizationalUnit — a part of a larger Organization (department, team, division) without independent legal status.

urn:solid:PeriodOfTime.label: PeriodOfTime
urn:solid:PeriodOfTime.description: A named or bounded interval of time — a year, an era, a meeting window, a coverage period.

urn:solid:PersonalProfileDocument.label: PersonalProfileDocument
urn:solid:PersonalProfileDocument.description: A document that describes a person — typically a FOAF or WebID profile.

urn:solid:Photo.label: Photo
urn:solid:Photo.description: A vCard Photo resource — a photographic image associated with a vCard.

urn:solid:PhysicalMedium.label: PhysicalMedium
urn:solid:PhysicalMedium.description: A material or physical carrier of a resource — paper, vinyl, magnetic tape, stone tablet.

urn:solid:Place.label: Place
urn:solid:Place.description: An entity that has a somewhat fixed physical extension — a city, building, landmark, room.

urn:solid:Plan.label: Plan
urn:solid:Plan.description: An entity describing a plan — a set of intended actions to achieve some goal.

urn:solid:Policy.label: Policy
urn:solid:Policy.description: A statement of policy applicable to the resource — terms of use, retention rules, access guidelines.

urn:solid:Post.label: Post
urn:solid:Post.description: A position within an organization that may be filled by an Agent — independent of who currently holds it.

urn:solid:PostalAddress.label: PostalAddress
urn:solid:PostalAddress.description: A structured postal address — street, locality, region, postal code, country.

urn:solid:PrimarySource.label: PrimarySource
urn:solid:PrimarySource.description: A qualified PROV derivation typing the relation as a primary-source attribution — first-hand origin.

urn:solid:Product.label: Product
urn:solid:Product.description: Anything that is made available for sale — a physical good, a service, or a digital item.

urn:solid:Profile.label: Profile
urn:solid:Profile.description: An ActivityStreams Object that describes another Object — typically supplemental information about an Actor (a richer biography, alternate display data) layered on top of the actor's primary record.

urn:solid:Project.label: Project
urn:solid:Project.description: A project — a collaborative undertaking with a goal.

urn:solid:Property.label: Property
urn:solid:Property.description: The class of RDF properties — predicates that connect a subject to a value (`name`, `knows`, `published`, etc.).

urn:solid:ProvenanceStatement.label: ProvenanceStatement
urn:solid:ProvenanceStatement.description: A statement about the provenance of a resource — its origin, custody history, transformations.

urn:solid:Public.label: Public
urn:solid:Public.description: The ActivityPub special-purpose IRI denoting the public audience — addressing an Activity to it makes the Activity visible to anyone, anywhere on the network.

urn:solid:Question.label: Question
urn:solid:Question.description: A question being asked — typically with one or more proposed answers (a poll).

urn:solid:Quotation.label: Quotation
urn:solid:Quotation.description: A PROV Derivation that represents a quoted excerpt from another entity, with attribution.

urn:solid:RDFSource.label: RDFSource
urn:solid:RDFSource.description: An LDP Resource whose state is represented as RDF — a Turtle, JSON-LD, or other RDF document.

urn:solid:Rating.label: Rating
urn:solid:Rating.description: A numeric or symbolic value expressing assessment quality — typically a star rating.

urn:solid:Read.label: Read
urn:solid:Read.description: The WAC Read access mode — permission to fetch the contents of a resource.

urn:solid:Recipe.label: Recipe
urn:solid:Recipe.description: A recipe — instructions for preparing a dish, with ingredients, steps, and yield.

urn:solid:Reject.label: Reject
urn:solid:Reject.description: An indication that the actor rejects the object — typically a Follow request or invitation.

urn:solid:Relationship.label: Relationship
urn:solid:Relationship.description: An ActivityStreams Object representing a typed relationship between two other Objects — typically two Actors connected by a relationship type (friend, colleague, follower).

urn:solid:Remove.label: Remove
urn:solid:Remove.description: An activity in which the actor is removing the object from the target.

urn:solid:Resource.label: Resource
urn:solid:Resource.description: An LDP Resource — any HTTP-addressable resource managed by an LDP server.

urn:solid:Restriction.label: Restriction
urn:solid:Restriction.description: An anonymous OWL class defined by a constraint on one property — e.g. "things whose `foaf:age` is at least 18".

urn:solid:Review.label: Review
urn:solid:Review.description: A review of an item — typically a Product or CreativeWork — by an author.

urn:solid:Revision.label: Revision
urn:solid:Revision.description: A PROV Derivation that represents a revised version of an entity — a substantive change without breaking identity continuity.

urn:solid:RightsStatement.label: RightsStatement
urn:solid:RightsStatement.description: A statement about the intellectual property rights held in or over a resource.

urn:solid:Service.label: Service
urn:solid:Service.description: An ActivityStreams actor representing a service — an automated, headless software offering.

urn:solid:Site.label: Site
urn:solid:Site.description: A physical location at which an Organization operates — an office, factory, branch, or campus.

urn:solid:SizeOrDuration.label: SizeOrDuration
urn:solid:SizeOrDuration.description: A measured size or duration of a resource — pages, bytes, runtime, dimensions.

urn:solid:SocialMediaPosting.label: SocialMediaPosting
urn:solid:SocialMediaPosting.description: A post to a social-media platform — tweet, toot, status update, microblog entry.

urn:solid:SoftwareAgent.label: SoftwareAgent
urn:solid:SoftwareAgent.description: A piece of software acting as an agent — a script, build tool, bot, or service.

urn:solid:SoftwareApplication.label: SoftwareApplication
urn:solid:SoftwareApplication.description: A software application — desktop, mobile, web, or server software.

urn:solid:Standard.label: Standard
urn:solid:Standard.description: A reference point against which other resources can be evaluated or compared — a specification, schema, or policy.

urn:solid:SymmetricProperty.label: SymmetricProperty
urn:solid:SymmetricProperty.description: An OWL property whose inverse is itself — if `A p B`, then `B p A`.

urn:solid:Tel.label: Tel
urn:solid:Tel.description: A vCard Tel resource — a structured telephone-number entry with type tags and value.

urn:solid:TentativeAccept.label: TentativeAccept
urn:solid:TentativeAccept.description: An ActivityStreams Activity indicating that the actor accepts the object provisionally — a soft "yes, probably" rather than a firm commitment.

urn:solid:TentativeReject.label: TentativeReject
urn:solid:TentativeReject.description: An ActivityStreams Activity indicating that the actor declines the object provisionally — a soft "probably no" rather than a firm refusal.

urn:solid:Thing.label: Thing
urn:solid:Thing.description: The OWL top class — every other class is a subclass of `owl:Thing`. Schema.org also uses a class called `Thing` as its root; both are aligned in this term.

urn:solid:Tombstone.label: Tombstone
urn:solid:Tombstone.description: A marker for an Object that previously existed but has been deleted.

urn:solid:Tracker.label: Tracker
urn:solid:Tracker.description: A container for tracking work items — typically a list of iCalendar Vtodos. The list-level counterpart to single-task Vtodo.

urn:solid:TransitiveProperty.label: TransitiveProperty
urn:solid:TransitiveProperty.description: An OWL property whose closure is the property itself — if `A p B` and `B p C`, then `A p C`.

urn:solid:Travel.label: Travel
urn:solid:Travel.description: An ActivityStreams Activity indicating that the actor is travelling between two locations — the origin is the `origin`, the destination is the `target`.

urn:solid:TypeIndex.label: TypeIndex
urn:solid:TypeIndex.description: A registry that maps RDF classes to the locations in a Solid pod where instances of those classes are stored.

urn:solid:TypeRegistration.label: TypeRegistration
urn:solid:TypeRegistration.description: An entry in a TypeIndex declaring where instances of a particular RDF class live in a Solid pod.

urn:solid:Undo.label: Undo
urn:solid:Undo.description: An indication that the actor is undoing a previous activity — typically used to retract a Like or Follow.

urn:solid:Update.label: Update
urn:solid:Update.description: An activity in which the actor has updated the object.

urn:solid:Usage.label: Usage
urn:solid:Usage.description: A qualified PROV usage event — the moment an Activity used an Entity as input.

urn:solid:VCard.label: VCard
urn:solid:VCard.description: A vCard — a structured contact card holding name, email, phone, address, and other contact details.

urn:solid:Vcalendar.label: Vcalendar
urn:solid:Vcalendar.description: An iCalendar container — the top-level wrapper holding a collection of Vevents, Vtodos, and other calendar components.

urn:solid:VerifiableCredential.label: VerifiableCredential
urn:solid:VerifiableCredential.description: A W3C Verifiable Credential — a tamper-evident, cryptographically-signed claim made by an issuer about a subject.

urn:solid:VerifiablePresentation.label: VerifiablePresentation
urn:solid:VerifiablePresentation.description: A W3C Verifiable Presentation — a holder-signed bundle of one or more VerifiableCredentials, prepared for a specific verifier.

urn:solid:Vevent.label: Vevent
urn:solid:Vevent.description: An iCalendar event — a scheduled occurrence with a start and end time, defined in RFC 5545 and mapped to RDF by the W3C iCal vocabulary.

urn:solid:Video.label: Video
urn:solid:Video.description: A video resource — used in ActivityPub for video attachments and stand-alone video posts.

urn:solid:VideoObject.label: VideoObject
urn:solid:VideoObject.description: A video file with structured metadata — duration, resolution, encoding, thumbnail.

urn:solid:View.label: View
urn:solid:View.description: An ActivityStreams Activity indicating that the actor viewed the object — typically visual content (an image, a video, a page).

urn:solid:Vjournal.label: Vjournal
urn:solid:Vjournal.description: An iCalendar journal entry — a dated note, log entry, or diary item, used to record what happened (rather than what's scheduled).

urn:solid:Vtodo.label: Vtodo
urn:solid:Vtodo.description: An iCalendar to-do item — a task that can be in progress, completed, or cancelled, with optional due dates.

urn:solid:WebPage.label: WebPage
urn:solid:WebPage.description: A web page — a single page on a website, identified by its URL.

urn:solid:WebSite.label: WebSite
urn:solid:WebSite.description: A website — a set of related web pages and resources at a common origin.

urn:solid:Write.label: Write
urn:solid:Write.description: The WAC Write access mode — permission to modify or delete the contents of a resource.

urn:solid:about.label: about
urn:solid:about.description: The subject matter of the resource — what it is about.

urn:solid:abstract.label: abstract
urn:solid:abstract.description: A summary of the resource — typically one paragraph.

urn:solid:accessRights.label: accessRights
urn:solid:accessRights.description: Information about who can access the resource — a free-text or `dcterms:RightsStatement` description of access policy.

urn:solid:accessService.label: accessService
urn:solid:accessService.description: A DCAT DataService through which a particular Distribution can be accessed — e.g. a SPARQL endpoint that exposes a downloadable dataset.

urn:solid:accessTo.label: accessTo
urn:solid:accessTo.description: The resource that an Authorization grants access to.

urn:solid:accessURL.label: accessURL
urn:solid:accessURL.description: A URL where the resources of a DCAT Distribution can be accessed — a landing page, API entry point, or query interface.

urn:solid:account.label: account
urn:solid:account.description: An online account held by the subject.

urn:solid:accountName.label: accountName
urn:solid:accountName.description: The name (username, handle) of an OnlineAccount on the service that hosts it.

urn:solid:accountServiceHomepage.label: accountServiceHomepage
urn:solid:accountServiceHomepage.description: The homepage of the online service that hosts the account.

urn:solid:accuracy.label: accuracy
urn:solid:accuracy.description: The accuracy of an ActivityStreams Place's coordinates, expressed as a percentage (0–100).

urn:solid:actedOnBehalfOf.label: actedOnBehalfOf
urn:solid:actedOnBehalfOf.description: An agent acted on behalf of another — delegation between agents.

urn:solid:additional-name.label: additional-name
urn:solid:additional-name.description: An additional or middle name of the person.

urn:solid:address.label: address
urn:solid:address.description: The postal address of the subject.

urn:solid:age.label: age
urn:solid:age.description: The age in years of the agent.

urn:solid:agentClass.label: agentClass
urn:solid:agentClass.description: A class of agents (e.g. `foaf:Agent` for everyone, `acl:AuthenticatedAgent` for any logged-in user) granted access by an Authorization.

urn:solid:agentGroup.label: agentGroup
urn:solid:agentGroup.description: A group of agents (a `vcard:Group` resource listing members by WebID) granted access by an Authorization.

urn:solid:allValuesFrom.label: allValuesFrom
urn:solid:allValuesFrom.description: On an OWL Restriction, asserts that every value of the constrained property must be an instance of a given class — a universal quantifier.

urn:solid:alsoKnownAs.label: alsoKnownAs
urn:solid:alsoKnownAs.description: An alternate identifier for an ActivityStreams Object — typically a previous identity an Actor used before migrating servers, kept as a back-reference so old followers can find them.

urn:solid:altLabel.label: altLabel
urn:solid:altLabel.description: An alternative lexical label for a SKOS Concept — a synonym, abbreviation, or other equivalent name.

urn:solid:alternateOf.label: alternateOf
urn:solid:alternateOf.description: Two Entities are alternates when they are different specializations of a common general Entity (same underlying thing, different views).

urn:solid:alternative.label: alternative
urn:solid:alternative.description: An alternative title or name for the resource.

urn:solid:altitude.label: altitude
urn:solid:altitude.description: The altitude of an ActivityStreams Place above sea level, expressed in metres unless `as:units` says otherwise.

urn:solid:alumniOf.label: alumniOf
urn:solid:alumniOf.description: An organization the person previously attended or worked for.

urn:solid:anniversary.label: anniversary
urn:solid:anniversary.description: An anniversary date associated with the subject — typically a wedding anniversary or other recurring date.

urn:solid:anyOf.label: anyOf
urn:solid:anyOf.description: On an ActivityStreams Question, the inclusive set of answer choices — voters may pick any number.

urn:solid:articleBody.label: articleBody
urn:solid:articleBody.description: The actual body of the article — its full text content.

urn:solid:assertionMethod.label: assertionMethod
urn:solid:assertionMethod.description: On a DID Document, verification methods authorised for asserting claims (issuing or signing VerifiableCredentials on behalf of the DID).

urn:solid:atLocation.label: atLocation
urn:solid:atLocation.description: The Location at which an Activity, Entity, or Agent occurred or was situated.

urn:solid:atTime.label: atTime
urn:solid:atTime.description: The time at which an InstantaneousEvent occurred — for PROV Generation, Usage, Invalidation, etc.

urn:solid:attachment.label: attachment
urn:solid:attachment.description: An object attached to or associated with the subject — typically images, files, or media.

urn:solid:attendee.label: attendee
urn:solid:attendee.description: An iCalendar participant in a Vevent or Vtodo — typically an Actor invited to attend or asked to act.

urn:solid:attributedTo.label: attributedTo
urn:solid:attributedTo.description: An entity to which the object is attributed — typically the author or creator.

urn:solid:audience.label: audience
urn:solid:audience.description: The intended audience of the object — who it is targeted at, regardless of who actually receives it.

urn:solid:authentication.label: authentication
urn:solid:authentication.description: On a DID Document, the verification methods authorised for proving control of the DID — used during login, challenge-response, and other identity-assertion flows.

urn:solid:author.label: author
urn:solid:author.description: The author of the creative work.

urn:solid:available.label: available
urn:solid:available.description: The date or period when the resource became (or will become) available.

urn:solid:basedNear.label: basedNear
urn:solid:basedNear.description: A geographic location near where the subject is based.

urn:solid:bcc.label: bcc
urn:solid:bcc.description: Blind carbon-copy recipients of the object — recipients hidden from other receivers.

urn:solid:bday.label: bday
urn:solid:bday.description: The full date of birth of the subject (year-month-day).

urn:solid:bibliographicCitation.label: bibliographicCitation
urn:solid:bibliographicCitation.description: A bibliographic reference for the resource — a formatted citation string.

urn:solid:birthday.label: birthday
urn:solid:birthday.description: The birthday of the agent — month and day, formatted as mm-dd.

urn:solid:broadMatch.label: broadMatch
urn:solid:broadMatch.description: A SKOS mapping asserting that a Concept in another scheme is broader than this Concept.

urn:solid:broader.label: broader
urn:solid:broader.description: A broader (parent) SKOS Concept in a hierarchy — "category-theory broader algebra".

urn:solid:bto.label: bto
urn:solid:bto.description: Private primary recipients of the object — "to" addresses hidden from other receivers.

urn:solid:byteSize.label: byteSize
urn:solid:byteSize.description: The size in bytes of a DCAT Distribution.

urn:solid:cardinality.label: cardinality
urn:solid:cardinality.description: On an OWL Restriction, asserts that the constrained property must have *exactly* this many values.

urn:solid:categories.label: categories
urn:solid:categories.description: iCalendar tags or categories for a Vevent/Vtodo — comma-separated keywords classifying the calendar item ("work", "personal", "travel").

urn:solid:cc.label: cc
urn:solid:cc.description: Secondary public recipients of the object — visible carbon-copy addresses.

urn:solid:changeNote.label: changeNote
urn:solid:changeNote.description: A SKOS note recording a change made to a Concept — typical use is the curator's log of edits to the term over time.

urn:solid:closeMatch.label: closeMatch
urn:solid:closeMatch.description: A SKOS mapping asserting that two Concepts in different ConceptSchemes are similar enough to be used interchangeably in some applications.

urn:solid:closed.label: closed
urn:solid:closed.description: Indicates that an ActivityStreams Question is closed — no further responses are accepted. The value may be a date-time, a boolean, or an Object describing how it was closed.

urn:solid:complementOf.label: complementOf
urn:solid:complementOf.description: OWL class expression: defines a class as the negation of another — instances of the new class are everything that is *not* an instance of the named class.

urn:solid:conformsTo.label: conformsTo
urn:solid:conformsTo.description: An established standard or specification to which the resource conforms.

urn:solid:contains.label: contains
urn:solid:contains.description: A resource contained by the LDP Container — i.e., a member created via HTTP POST to the container.

urn:solid:content.label: content
urn:solid:content.description: The textual body of the object — its content in a natural-language string (often HTML).

urn:solid:contentMap.label: contentMap
urn:solid:contentMap.description: Language-tagged variants of an ActivityStreams Object's `content` — keys are BCP 47 language tags, values are the localised content (often HTML).

urn:solid:context.label: context
urn:solid:context.description: The context within which the object exists or to which it relates — typically a conversation thread.

urn:solid:contributor.label: contributor
urn:solid:contributor.description: An entity responsible for making contributions to the resource — secondary to the principal creator.

urn:solid:controller.label: controller
urn:solid:controller.description: The Actor authorised to make changes to a DID Document or verification method — the entity holding the private key behind the public material.

urn:solid:country-name.label: country-name
urn:solid:country-name.description: The country name of an Address — typically as a string.

urn:solid:created.label: created
urn:solid:created.description: The date the resource was created.

urn:solid:creator.label: creator
urn:solid:creator.description: An entity primarily responsible for making the resource.

urn:solid:credentialStatus.label: credentialStatus
urn:solid:credentialStatus.description: A reference to a status mechanism for a VerifiableCredential — e.g. a revocation list — that verifiers consult to check whether the credential is still active.

urn:solid:credentialSubject.label: credentialSubject
urn:solid:credentialSubject.description: The entity that a VerifiableCredential makes claims about — most often an Actor identified by a DID or WebID.

urn:solid:current.label: current
urn:solid:current.description: The page of an ActivityStreams Collection that contains the most recent items — clients seeking "what's new" start here rather than at `first`.

urn:solid:currentProject.label: currentProject
urn:solid:currentProject.description: A project the person is currently active on.

urn:solid:date.label: date
urn:solid:date.description: A point or period of time associated with the resource — generic when more specific date predicates don't apply.

urn:solid:dateAccepted.label: dateAccepted
urn:solid:dateAccepted.description: The date the resource was formally accepted — typically by a publisher, peer reviewer, or governing body.

urn:solid:dateCopyrighted.label: dateCopyrighted
urn:solid:dateCopyrighted.description: The date of a statement of copyright over the resource.

urn:solid:dateCreated.label: dateCreated
urn:solid:dateCreated.description: The date the resource was created.

urn:solid:dateModified.label: dateModified
urn:solid:dateModified.description: The date the resource was last modified.

urn:solid:datePublished.label: datePublished
urn:solid:datePublished.description: The date the resource was published — when it became publicly available.

urn:solid:dateSubmitted.label: dateSubmitted
urn:solid:dateSubmitted.description: The date the resource was formally submitted — typically to a publisher, conference, or review process.

urn:solid:default.label: default
urn:solid:default.description: Marks an Authorization as the default access policy inherited by descendants of a Container.

urn:solid:definition.label: definition
urn:solid:definition.description: A complete explanation of the intended meaning of a SKOS Concept.

urn:solid:deleted.label: deleted
urn:solid:deleted.description: On an ActivityStreams Tombstone, the date-time at which the original Object was deleted.

urn:solid:depiction.label: depiction
urn:solid:depiction.description: An image that depicts the subject.

urn:solid:describes.label: describes
urn:solid:describes.description: The Object that an ActivityStreams Profile is about — links a profile-style description to its subject.

urn:solid:description.label: description
urn:solid:description.description: An account of the resource — a free-text description.

urn:solid:differentFrom.label: differentFrom
urn:solid:differentFrom.description: Asserts that two OWL individuals are *not* the same — explicit negation, useful in worlds where the open-world assumption would otherwise leave identity ambiguous.

urn:solid:disjointWith.label: disjointWith
urn:solid:disjointWith.description: Asserts that two OWL classes have no instances in common — nothing can be both at once.

urn:solid:domain.label: domain
urn:solid:domain.description: Declares which class an RDF property is meant to be applied to — its subject type.

urn:solid:downloadURL.label: downloadURL
urn:solid:downloadURL.description: A direct file URL where a DCAT Distribution can be downloaded.

urn:solid:dtend.label: dtend
urn:solid:dtend.description: The end date-time of an iCalendar Vevent — when the event finishes.

urn:solid:dtstart.label: dtstart
urn:solid:dtstart.description: The start date-time of an iCalendar Vevent or Vtodo — when the event begins or when the task becomes actionable.

urn:solid:duration.label: duration
urn:solid:duration.description: How long the object lasts — for time-bounded objects like events, audio, or video.

urn:solid:editor.label: editor
urn:solid:editor.description: The editor of a CreativeWork — typically a Person who supervised, revised, or curated the content.

urn:solid:editorialNote.label: editorialNote
urn:solid:editorialNote.description: A SKOS note for vocabulary maintainers — internal guidance, open questions, things to revisit later. Not intended for end users.

urn:solid:educationLevel.label: educationLevel
urn:solid:educationLevel.description: The general education level the resource targets — primary, secondary, undergraduate, professional, etc.

urn:solid:email.label: email
urn:solid:email.description: An email address for the subject, as a plain string.

urn:solid:endTime.label: endTime
urn:solid:endTime.description: The date and time the object ends.

urn:solid:endedAtTime.label: endedAtTime
urn:solid:endedAtTime.description: The time at which the activity ended.

urn:solid:endpointDescription.label: endpointDescription
urn:solid:endpointDescription.description: A machine-readable description of how to interact with a DCAT DataService — e.g. an OpenAPI document or SPARQL Service Description.

urn:solid:endpointURL.label: endpointURL
urn:solid:endpointURL.description: The root URL of a DCAT DataService — the address a client connects to to invoke the service.

urn:solid:endpoints.label: endpoints
urn:solid:endpoints.description: Container for additional service endpoints exposed by an ActivityPub Actor — most importantly `sharedInbox`, but also `proxyUrl`, OAuth endpoints, and others.

urn:solid:equivalentClass.label: equivalentClass
urn:solid:equivalentClass.description: Asserts that two OWL classes have identical extensions — every instance of one is also an instance of the other and vice versa.

urn:solid:equivalentProperty.label: equivalentProperty
urn:solid:equivalentProperty.description: Asserts that two OWL properties always relate the same subjects to the same objects — interchangeable in any triple.

urn:solid:exactMatch.label: exactMatch
urn:solid:exactMatch.description: A SKOS mapping asserting that two Concepts in different ConceptSchemes are equivalent for retrieval purposes.

urn:solid:example.label: example
urn:solid:example.description: An example illustrating the use of a SKOS Concept.

urn:solid:expirationDate.label: expirationDate
urn:solid:expirationDate.description: The date-time at which a VerifiableCredential ceases to be valid — verifiers SHOULD reject it after this instant.

urn:solid:extent.label: extent
urn:solid:extent.description: The size or duration of the resource — pages, bytes, runtime length.

urn:solid:family-name.label: family-name
urn:solid:family-name.description: The vCard family name (surname) of a person.

urn:solid:familyName.label: familyName
urn:solid:familyName.description: The family name (surname) of the person.

urn:solid:first.label: first
urn:solid:first.description: The first page of a paginated ActivityStreams Collection — the entry point a client uses to start walking the pagination chain.

urn:solid:firstName.label: firstName
urn:solid:firstName.description: The first name of a person.

urn:solid:fn.label: fn
urn:solid:fn.description: Formatted name — the display name of the subject as a single string.

urn:solid:follower.label: follower
urn:solid:follower.description: An agent that follows the subject — receiving updates from them.

urn:solid:followers.label: followers
urn:solid:followers.description: The Collection of Actors who follow an ActivityPub Actor — used both for delivery (servers fan Activities out to followers) and for display.

urn:solid:following.label: following
urn:solid:following.description: The Collection of Actors that an ActivityPub Actor follows — the source side of the social graph.

urn:solid:forClass.label: forClass
urn:solid:forClass.description: The RDF class that a TypeRegistration is for — what type of resources live at the registered location.

urn:solid:format.label: format
urn:solid:format.description: The file format, physical medium, or dimensions of the resource.

urn:solid:formerType.label: formerType
urn:solid:formerType.description: On an ActivityStreams Tombstone, the type the deleted Object had before it was removed — preserves enough metadata for clients to know what they lost.

urn:solid:gender.label: gender
urn:solid:gender.description: The gender of the agent — a free-form string in FOAF tradition.

urn:solid:generated.label: generated
urn:solid:generated.description: Inverse of `prov:wasGeneratedBy` — the Entity that this Activity produced.

urn:solid:generatedAtTime.label: generatedAtTime
urn:solid:generatedAtTime.description: The time at which the entity was completely generated by some activity.

urn:solid:generator.label: generator
urn:solid:generator.description: The application that generated the object — typically a software client or service.

urn:solid:given-name.label: given-name
urn:solid:given-name.description: The vCard given name (first name) of a person.

urn:solid:givenName.label: givenName
urn:solid:givenName.description: The given name of a person — the personal name distinct from the family name.

urn:solid:hadActivity.label: hadActivity
urn:solid:hadActivity.description: An activity that contributed to a qualified PROV relation — typically attached to a qualified usage, generation, or derivation.

urn:solid:hadGeneration.label: hadGeneration
urn:solid:hadGeneration.description: Links a use of an Entity to the qualified Generation event in which that Entity was created — letting consumers reason about which version was used.

urn:solid:hadMember.label: hadMember
urn:solid:hadMember.description: An entity that was a member of a PROV Collection.

urn:solid:hadPlan.label: hadPlan
urn:solid:hadPlan.description: The Plan that an Activity followed — used inside a qualified PROV Association.

urn:solid:hadPrimarySource.label: hadPrimarySource
urn:solid:hadPrimarySource.description: An entity that is the primary source — the original first-hand source — for the subject entity.

urn:solid:hadRole.label: hadRole
urn:solid:hadRole.description: The role an Agent or Entity played in a qualified PROV relation — "author", "editor", "raw input", etc.

urn:solid:hadUsage.label: hadUsage
urn:solid:hadUsage.description: Inside a qualified PROV pattern, links to the `prov:Usage` event whose entity participated in this relationship — typically used on a `prov:Derivation` to record the use that supplied its input.

urn:solid:hasAddress.label: hasAddress
urn:solid:hasAddress.description: A postal address associated with the subject.

urn:solid:hasCalendarBusy.label: hasCalendarBusy
urn:solid:hasCalendarBusy.description: A URL of the subject's free/busy calendar — shows availability without exposing event details.

urn:solid:hasCalendarLink.label: hasCalendarLink
urn:solid:hasCalendarLink.description: A URL of the subject's calendar — typically an iCalendar (.ics) feed or web calendar.

urn:solid:hasCalendarRequest.label: hasCalendarRequest
urn:solid:hasCalendarRequest.description: A vCard's URL for accepting calendar requests — the endpoint where meeting requests, scheduling proposals, or iCalendar invitations should be sent.

urn:solid:hasCategory.label: hasCategory
urn:solid:hasCategory.description: A category or tag for the vCard — describing what kind of contact it is.

urn:solid:hasEmail.label: hasEmail
urn:solid:hasEmail.description: An email address associated with the subject — typically a `mailto:` IRI.

urn:solid:hasFormat.label: hasFormat
urn:solid:hasFormat.description: A related resource that is the same intellectual content but in a different format — e.g. a PDF version of an HTML article.

urn:solid:hasGender.label: hasGender
urn:solid:hasGender.description: The gender of the agent — typically referencing one of vCard's enumerated Gender values.

urn:solid:hasGeo.label: hasGeo
urn:solid:hasGeo.description: Geographic coordinates associated with the subject — typically a `geo:` IRI carrying lat/long.

urn:solid:hasInstantMessage.label: hasInstantMessage
urn:solid:hasInstantMessage.description: An instant-messaging address for the subject — typically an `xmpp:`, `matrix:`, or other chat URI.

urn:solid:hasKey.label: hasKey
urn:solid:hasKey.description: A cryptographic public key associated with the vCard's owner — for encryption or signature verification.

urn:solid:hasLanguage.label: hasLanguage
urn:solid:hasLanguage.description: A language the subject communicates in — typically a BCP 47 language tag.

urn:solid:hasLogo.label: hasLogo
urn:solid:hasLogo.description: A logo image associated with the vCard — typically the brand mark of an Organization.

urn:solid:hasMember.label: hasMember
urn:solid:hasMember.description: A member of the vCard Group.

urn:solid:hasMemberRelation.label: hasMemberRelation
urn:solid:hasMemberRelation.description: The predicate that should be used to express membership in a DirectContainer or IndirectContainer.

urn:solid:hasName.label: hasName
urn:solid:hasName.description: A structured Name resource for the subject — separates given/family/additional/prefix/suffix into a Name object.

urn:solid:hasPart.label: hasPart
urn:solid:hasPart.description: A related resource that is included as a part of the described resource.

urn:solid:hasPhoto.label: hasPhoto
urn:solid:hasPhoto.description: A photo associated with the subject — typically a portrait.

urn:solid:hasRelated.label: hasRelated
urn:solid:hasRelated.description: A related contact for the vCard — typically another person (spouse, child, colleague) connected to the subject.

urn:solid:hasSound.label: hasSound
urn:solid:hasSound.description: A vCard's URL pointing at an audio recording — typically a pronunciation of the name or a personal voice intro.

urn:solid:hasSource.label: hasSource
urn:solid:hasSource.description: A source document for the vCard's information — typically a website or directory the data came from.

urn:solid:hasSubOrganization.label: hasSubOrganization
urn:solid:hasSubOrganization.description: An OrganizationalUnit (department, team, division) that is part of the parent Organization.

urn:solid:hasTelephone.label: hasTelephone
urn:solid:hasTelephone.description: A telephone number associated with the subject — typically a `tel:` IRI.

urn:solid:hasTopConcept.label: hasTopConcept
urn:solid:hasTopConcept.description: A top-level (root) Concept of the SKOS ConceptScheme — has no broader concept within the scheme.

urn:solid:hasUID.label: hasUID
urn:solid:hasUID.description: A globally unique identifier for the vCard — typically a UUID or other long-lived ID.

urn:solid:hasURL.label: hasURL
urn:solid:hasURL.description: A URL associated with the subject — any web link, not necessarily the canonical homepage.

urn:solid:hasUnit.label: hasUnit
urn:solid:hasUnit.description: An OrganizationalUnit that is part of the parent Organization — narrower than `hasSubOrganization`.

urn:solid:hasValue.label: hasValue
urn:solid:hasValue.description: On an OWL Restriction, asserts that the constrained property must have one specific value — the most precise form of class definition.

urn:solid:hasVersion.label: hasVersion
urn:solid:hasVersion.description: A related resource that is a version, edition, or adaptation of the described resource.

urn:solid:headline.label: headline
urn:solid:headline.description: The headline of the article — a short, attention-grabbing title line.

urn:solid:height.label: height
urn:solid:height.description: The height in pixels of an ActivityStreams Object — typically an Image, Video, or Link to a visual resource.

urn:solid:heldBy.label: heldBy
urn:solid:heldBy.description: Inverse of `org:holds` — names the Agent currently filling an organizational Post.

urn:solid:hiddenLabel.label: hiddenLabel
urn:solid:hiddenLabel.description: A non-display label for a SKOS Concept — used to support search but not shown in UIs.

urn:solid:historyNote.label: historyNote
urn:solid:historyNote.description: A SKOS note describing the history of a Concept — its origin, evolution, and how its meaning has shifted over time.

urn:solid:holder.label: holder
urn:solid:holder.description: On a VerifiablePresentation, the Actor presenting the credentials — typically (but not always) also the credentialSubject.

urn:solid:holds.label: holds
urn:solid:holds.description: An ORG Post (position) that an Agent currently holds within an Organization.

urn:solid:homepage.label: homepage
urn:solid:homepage.description: A homepage for the subject — a top-level page about the agent.

urn:solid:honorific-prefix.label: honorific-prefix
urn:solid:honorific-prefix.description: An honorific prefix preceding the person's name — Mr, Mrs, Dr, Prof, etc.

urn:solid:honorific-suffix.label: honorific-suffix
urn:solid:honorific-suffix.description: An honorific suffix following the person's name — PhD, Esq, Jr, Sr, etc.

urn:solid:href.label: href
urn:solid:href.description: The target URL of an ActivityStreams Link — the resource the Link points at.

urn:solid:hreflang.label: hreflang
urn:solid:hreflang.description: The language of the resource at an ActivityStreams Link's `href` — a BCP 47 language tag (`en`, `en-GB`, `pt-BR`).

urn:solid:icon.label: icon
urn:solid:icon.description: A small image representing the object — typically a square avatar or favicon.

urn:solid:identifier.label: identifier
urn:solid:identifier.description: An unambiguous reference to the resource within a given context.

urn:solid:img.label: img
urn:solid:img.description: An image that represents the person — typically a headshot or portrait.

urn:solid:inDataset.label: inDataset
urn:solid:inDataset.description: Links a DCAT Distribution to the Dataset it represents — inverse of `dcat:distribution`.

urn:solid:inLanguage.label: inLanguage
urn:solid:inLanguage.description: The language a CreativeWork is written in — typically a BCP 47 language tag.

urn:solid:inReplyTo.label: inReplyTo
urn:solid:inReplyTo.description: An object the current object is a reply to.

urn:solid:inScheme.label: inScheme
urn:solid:inScheme.description: The SKOS ConceptScheme that the Concept is a member of.

urn:solid:inbox.label: inbox
urn:solid:inbox.description: An LDN inbox — a container that accepts notifications about the resource via HTTP POST.

urn:solid:insertedContentRelation.label: insertedContentRelation
urn:solid:insertedContentRelation.description: On an IndirectContainer, the predicate the server uses to look up the actual member from the POSTed content.

urn:solid:instance.label: instance
urn:solid:instance.description: A single resource that's an instance of the class declared by the TypeRegistration.

urn:solid:instanceContainer.label: instanceContainer
urn:solid:instanceContainer.description: A Container holding instances of the class declared by a TypeRegistration.

urn:solid:instructionalMethod.label: instructionalMethod
urn:solid:instructionalMethod.description: A process used to engender knowledge, attitudes, or skills using the resource — pedagogy.

urn:solid:instrument.label: instrument
urn:solid:instrument.description: An entity used by an ActivityStreams Activity to perform its action — e.g. a tool, a client application, or a means by which the Activity was carried out.

urn:solid:interest.label: interest
urn:solid:interest.description: A page about a topic of interest to the agent.

urn:solid:intersectionOf.label: intersectionOf
urn:solid:intersectionOf.description: OWL class expression: defines a class as the intersection of a list of other classes — instances of the new class are instances of all listed classes.

urn:solid:invalidated.label: invalidated
urn:solid:invalidated.description: An Entity that this PROV Activity destroyed, consumed, or rendered unusable — after invalidation the Entity is no longer available for further use.

urn:solid:invalidatedAtTime.label: invalidatedAtTime
urn:solid:invalidatedAtTime.description: The time at which an Entity ceased to exist.

urn:solid:inverseOf.label: inverseOf
urn:solid:inverseOf.description: Asserts that two OWL properties are inverses — `A p1 B` if and only if `B p2 A`.

urn:solid:isDefinedBy.label: isDefinedBy
urn:solid:isDefinedBy.description: Points at the resource that *defines* a term — typically the vocabulary document the term was minted in.

urn:solid:isFormatOf.label: isFormatOf
urn:solid:isFormatOf.description: A related resource that is the same intellectual content of which the described resource is a different-format rendition.

urn:solid:isMemberOfRelation.label: isMemberOfRelation
urn:solid:isMemberOfRelation.description: The predicate the server adds in the *inverse* direction when a new resource is POSTed to a DirectContainer or IndirectContainer.

urn:solid:isPartOf.label: isPartOf
urn:solid:isPartOf.description: A related resource of which the described resource is a part.

urn:solid:isPrimaryTopicOf.label: isPrimaryTopicOf
urn:solid:isPrimaryTopicOf.description: A document of which the subject is the primary topic — the inverse of `primaryTopic`.

urn:solid:isReferencedBy.label: isReferencedBy
urn:solid:isReferencedBy.description: A related resource that references, cites, or otherwise points to the described resource.

urn:solid:isReplacedBy.label: isReplacedBy
urn:solid:isReplacedBy.description: A related resource that supplants, displaces, or supersedes the described resource.

urn:solid:isRequiredBy.label: isRequiredBy
urn:solid:isRequiredBy.description: A related resource that requires the described resource to support its function or coherence.

urn:solid:isVersionOf.label: isVersionOf
urn:solid:isVersionOf.description: A related resource of which the described resource is a version, edition, or adaptation.

urn:solid:issuanceDate.label: issuanceDate
urn:solid:issuanceDate.description: The date-time at which a VerifiableCredential was issued — the credential is not considered valid before this instant.

urn:solid:issued.label: issued
urn:solid:issued.description: The date the resource was formally issued or published.

urn:solid:issuer.label: issuer
urn:solid:issuer.description: The Actor that issued a VerifiableCredential — the party whose key signed the cryptographic proof and whose authority backs the claim.

urn:solid:items.label: items
urn:solid:items.description: The members of an ActivityStreams Collection (or a CollectionPage), in no specified order.

urn:solid:jabberID.label: jabberID
urn:solid:jabberID.description: A Jabber/XMPP identifier for the Agent.

urn:solid:keyword.label: keyword
urn:solid:keyword.description: A keyword or tag describing a DCAT Dataset or Catalog — repeated for multiple keywords.

urn:solid:keywords.label: keywords
urn:solid:keywords.description: Keywords or tags describing the resource — typically as a comma-separated string or a list.

urn:solid:knows.label: knows
urn:solid:knows.description: A person known by the subject — a directed acquaintance relationship.

urn:solid:knowsAbout.label: knowsAbout
urn:solid:knowsAbout.description: A topic the agent has expertise in or knowledge of.

urn:solid:knowsLanguage.label: knowsLanguage
urn:solid:knowsLanguage.description: A language the person speaks, writes, or otherwise communicates in.

urn:solid:label.label: label
urn:solid:label.description: A human-readable name for a resource — short, plain text, suitable for UI display.

urn:solid:landingPage.label: landingPage
urn:solid:landingPage.description: A web page that gives access to a DCAT Dataset, its Distributions, and additional information.

urn:solid:language.label: language
urn:solid:language.description: A language of the resource — typically a BCP 47 tag.

urn:solid:last.label: last
urn:solid:last.description: The final page of a paginated ActivityStreams Collection — the entry point for clients that want to start at the end (oldest activities, most recent post for chronologically reversed orderings).

urn:solid:lastName.label: lastName
urn:solid:lastName.description: The last name of a person.

urn:solid:latitude.label: latitude
urn:solid:latitude.description: The latitude of a location, in decimal degrees (WGS-84).

urn:solid:license.label: license
urn:solid:license.description: A legal document giving official permission to do something with the resource.

urn:solid:liked.label: liked
urn:solid:liked.description: The Collection of Objects an ActivityPub Actor has liked — the Actor's history of `Like` activities, presented as a queryable list.

urn:solid:locality.label: locality
urn:solid:locality.description: The locality (city, town, village) of an Address.

urn:solid:location.label: location
urn:solid:location.description: The location associated with the subject — typically a Place, address, or geographic coordinates.

urn:solid:loginEndpoint.label: loginEndpoint
urn:solid:loginEndpoint.description: The login endpoint URL for a Solid OIDC provider.

urn:solid:logoutEndpoint.label: logoutEndpoint
urn:solid:logoutEndpoint.description: The logout endpoint URL for a Solid OIDC provider.

urn:solid:longitude.label: longitude
urn:solid:longitude.description: The longitude of a location, in decimal degrees (WGS-84).

urn:solid:made.label: made
urn:solid:made.description: A thing the agent made — the inverse of `maker`.

urn:solid:maker.label: maker
urn:solid:maker.description: An agent that made the subject — the inverse of `made`.

urn:solid:mappingRelation.label: mappingRelation
urn:solid:mappingRelation.description: Superproperty of all SKOS cross-scheme mapping relations — `exactMatch`, `closeMatch`, `broadMatch`, `narrowMatch`, `relatedMatch`. Asserts that two Concepts in different schemes are related, without specifying how.

urn:solid:maxCardinality.label: maxCardinality
urn:solid:maxCardinality.description: On an OWL Restriction, asserts that the constrained property must have *at most* this many values.

urn:solid:mbox.label: mbox
urn:solid:mbox.description: A personal mailbox — typically a mailto: IRI.

urn:solid:mbox_sha1sum.label: mbox_sha1sum
urn:solid:mbox_sha1sum.description: The SHA-1 hash of the agent's mailbox URI — a privacy-preserving inverse-functional identifier.

urn:solid:mediaType.label: mediaType
urn:solid:mediaType.description: The MIME media type of the object — `image/png`, `text/html`, etc.

urn:solid:mediator.label: mediator
urn:solid:mediator.description: An intermediary that mediates access to or use of the resource — typically for educational or curated content.

urn:solid:medium.label: medium
urn:solid:medium.description: The material or physical carrier of the resource.

urn:solid:member.label: member
urn:solid:member.description: An agent that is a member of the group.

urn:solid:memberList.label: memberList
urn:solid:memberList.description: An ordered list of members of a SKOS OrderedCollection — preserves sequence in a way that the unordered `skos:member` cannot.

urn:solid:memberOf.label: memberOf
urn:solid:memberOf.description: An Organization (or Group) the Agent is a member of — the inverse of `member`.

urn:solid:membershipResource.label: membershipResource
urn:solid:membershipResource.description: The resource that membership triples for a DirectContainer or IndirectContainer are added to.

urn:solid:minCardinality.label: minCardinality
urn:solid:minCardinality.description: On an OWL Restriction, asserts that the constrained property must have *at least* this many values.

urn:solid:mode.label: mode
urn:solid:mode.description: An access mode granted by a Web Access Control Authorization — Read, Write, Append, or Control.

urn:solid:modified.label: modified
urn:solid:modified.description: The date the resource was last modified.

urn:solid:movedTo.label: movedTo
urn:solid:movedTo.description: On an ActivityStreams Actor, the new identity URI the Actor has migrated to — the forwarding address left behind on the old account.

urn:solid:nameMap.label: nameMap
urn:solid:nameMap.description: Language-tagged variants of an ActivityStreams Object's `name` — keys are BCP 47 language tags, values are the localised name strings.

urn:solid:narrowMatch.label: narrowMatch
urn:solid:narrowMatch.description: A SKOS mapping asserting that a Concept in another scheme is narrower than this Concept.

urn:solid:narrower.label: narrower
urn:solid:narrower.description: A narrower (child) SKOS Concept in a hierarchy — the inverse of `broader`.

urn:solid:next.label: next
urn:solid:next.description: The next page in an ActivityStreams CollectionPage chain — the URL the client follows to advance through pagination.

urn:solid:nick.label: nick
urn:solid:nick.description: A short informal nickname for the subject — typically a chat handle or screen name.

urn:solid:notation.label: notation
urn:solid:notation.description: A symbolic identifier for a SKOS Concept within a particular notation system (Dewey numbers, ISBN-style codes, taxonomy IDs).

urn:solid:oidcIssuer.label: oidcIssuer
urn:solid:oidcIssuer.description: The OpenID Connect issuer that this WebID trusts to authenticate it.

urn:solid:onProperty.label: onProperty
urn:solid:onProperty.description: On an OWL Restriction, the property being constrained.

urn:solid:oneOf.label: oneOf
urn:solid:oneOf.description: On an ActivityStreams Question, the exclusive set of answer choices — voters pick exactly one.

urn:solid:openid.label: openid
urn:solid:openid.description: An OpenID identifier for the Agent — a document used to verify the Agent's identity.

urn:solid:orderedItems.label: orderedItems
urn:solid:orderedItems.description: The ordered members of an ActivityStreams OrderedCollection or OrderedCollectionPage — sequence is significant.

urn:solid:organization-name.label: organization-name
urn:solid:organization-name.description: The name of the organization the person is affiliated with — typically the employer.

urn:solid:organizer.label: organizer
urn:solid:organizer.description: The Actor responsible for an iCalendar Vevent or Vtodo — the owner who scheduled it and who attendees reply to.

urn:solid:origin.label: origin
urn:solid:origin.description: Where an ActivityStreams Activity comes *from* — the source side of a movement, transfer, or invitation, complementing `as:target` (the destination).

urn:solid:outbox.label: outbox
urn:solid:outbox.description: The OrderedCollection of Activities an ActivityPub Actor has published — POSTing to it is how the Actor sends new Activities to the network.

urn:solid:owner.label: owner
urn:solid:owner.description: An agent that owns the resource — typically used to declare pod ownership.

urn:solid:ownerOf.label: ownerOf
urn:solid:ownerOf.description: A pod or resource the agent owns — the inverse of `owner`.

urn:solid:page.label: page
urn:solid:page.description: A document about the subject — any page that describes or discusses it.

urn:solid:partOf.label: partOf
urn:solid:partOf.description: Identifies the parent Collection that an ActivityStreams CollectionPage is a slice of — lets the client jump from a page back to the whole.

urn:solid:pastProject.label: pastProject
urn:solid:pastProject.description: A project the person is no longer active on.

urn:solid:phone.label: phone
urn:solid:phone.description: A phone number for the agent — typically a `tel:` IRI.

urn:solid:postIn.label: postIn
urn:solid:postIn.description: Links a Post to the Organization in which it sits.

urn:solid:postal-code.label: postal-code
urn:solid:postal-code.description: The postal code (ZIP code) of an Address.

urn:solid:prefLabel.label: prefLabel
urn:solid:prefLabel.description: The preferred lexical label for a SKOS Concept — its canonical name in a given language.

urn:solid:preferencesFile.label: preferencesFile
urn:solid:preferencesFile.description: A document containing the subject's private preferences.

urn:solid:preferredUsername.label: preferredUsername
urn:solid:preferredUsername.description: An ActivityPub Actor's preferred short username — the local part used in `@user@host` mention syntax.

urn:solid:prev.label: prev
urn:solid:prev.description: The previous page in an ActivityStreams CollectionPage chain — the URL the client follows to scroll back through pagination.

urn:solid:preview.label: preview
urn:solid:preview.description: An object that provides a preview of the subject — typically a thumbnail image or a snippet.

urn:solid:primaryTopic.label: primaryTopic
urn:solid:primaryTopic.description: The primary topic of a document — the thing the document is principally about.

urn:solid:privateTypeIndex.label: privateTypeIndex
urn:solid:privateTypeIndex.description: The private TypeIndex for a WebID — an access-controlled registry of where personal data of each type lives.

urn:solid:profileSubject.label: profileSubject
urn:solid:profileSubject.description: The subject (Person) that a profile document is about.

urn:solid:proof.label: proof
urn:solid:proof.description: A cryptographic proof attached to a VerifiableCredential or VerifiablePresentation — what verifiers check to confirm the document hasn't been tampered with and was signed by the claimed party.

urn:solid:provenance.label: provenance
urn:solid:provenance.description: A statement of any changes in ownership and custody of the resource since its creation — its provenance trail.

urn:solid:publicTypeIndex.label: publicTypeIndex
urn:solid:publicTypeIndex.description: The public TypeIndex for a WebID — a world-readable registry of where public data of each type lives.

urn:solid:publications.label: publications
urn:solid:publications.description: A document listing the publications of the person.

urn:solid:published.label: published
urn:solid:published.description: The date and time the object was published — when it went public.

urn:solid:publisher.label: publisher
urn:solid:publisher.description: An entity responsible for making the resource available.

urn:solid:qualifiedAssociation.label: qualifiedAssociation
urn:solid:qualifiedAssociation.description: A qualified PROV Association linked to the activity — adds role and plan to a `wasAssociatedWith` relation.

urn:solid:qualifiedAttribution.label: qualifiedAttribution
urn:solid:qualifiedAttribution.description: A qualified PROV Attribution linked to the entity — adds role and timing to a `wasAttributedTo` relation.

urn:solid:qualifiedDerivation.label: qualifiedDerivation
urn:solid:qualifiedDerivation.description: A qualified PROV Derivation linked to the entity — adds role, activity, and other context to a `wasDerivedFrom` relation.

urn:solid:qualifiedGeneration.label: qualifiedGeneration
urn:solid:qualifiedGeneration.description: Links an Entity to the `prov:Generation` instance describing the activity, time, and role in which the Entity was created.

urn:solid:qualifiedInvalidation.label: qualifiedInvalidation
urn:solid:qualifiedInvalidation.description: Links an Entity to a `prov:Invalidation` instance describing the activity, time, and circumstances in which the Entity ceased to exist.

urn:solid:qualifiedUsage.label: qualifiedUsage
urn:solid:qualifiedUsage.description: Links an Activity to a `prov:Usage` instance that adds detail (which entity, when, in what role) to a plain `prov:used` link.

urn:solid:radius.label: radius
urn:solid:radius.description: The radius around an ActivityStreams Place's centre point that the Place covers — a circular area, in metres unless `as:units` says otherwise.

urn:solid:range.label: range
urn:solid:range.description: Declares the type of values an RDF property is meant to take — its object type.

urn:solid:references.label: references
urn:solid:references.description: A related resource that is referenced, cited, or otherwise pointed to by the described resource.

urn:solid:region.label: region
urn:solid:region.description: The region (state, province, prefecture) of an Address.

urn:solid:rel.label: rel
urn:solid:rel.description: The link relation type of an ActivityStreams Link — semantic role of the connection (canonical, alternate, prev, next, …).

urn:solid:related.label: related
urn:solid:related.description: A SKOS Concept that is associatively (non-hierarchically) related to the subject Concept.

urn:solid:relatedMatch.label: relatedMatch
urn:solid:relatedMatch.description: Asserts an associative (non-hierarchical) link between two SKOS Concepts in different schemes — the cross-scheme analogue of `skos:related`.

urn:solid:relation.label: relation
urn:solid:relation.description: A related resource — generic relation when more specific predicates don't apply.

urn:solid:replaces.label: replaces
urn:solid:replaces.description: A related resource that the described resource supplants, displaces, or supersedes.

urn:solid:replies.label: replies
urn:solid:replies.description: A Collection of objects that are responses to the subject — the reverse of `inReplyTo`.

urn:solid:requires.label: requires
urn:solid:requires.description: A related resource that is required by the described resource to support its function or coherence.

urn:solid:result.label: result
urn:solid:result.description: Describes the result produced by an ActivityStreams Activity — for example, the booking returned by a Reservation.

urn:solid:rights.label: rights
urn:solid:rights.description: Information about rights held in and over the resource — copyright, IP, access restrictions.

urn:solid:rightsHolder.label: rightsHolder
urn:solid:rightsHolder.description: An agent owning or managing rights over the resource — the copyright holder, IP owner, or licensing controller.

urn:solid:role.label: role
urn:solid:role.description: The job role or function the person performs within an organization.

urn:solid:rrule.label: rrule
urn:solid:rrule.description: An iCalendar recurrence rule — declares the pattern by which a Vevent or Vtodo repeats (daily, weekly, every other Tuesday, …).

urn:solid:sameAs.label: sameAs
urn:solid:sameAs.description: An external reference URL that unambiguously identifies the subject — typically a profile or canonical page on another site.

urn:solid:schoolHomepage.label: schoolHomepage
urn:solid:schoolHomepage.description: A homepage of a school (or other educational institution) the person attended.

urn:solid:scopeNote.label: scopeNote
urn:solid:scopeNote.description: A SKOS note clarifying the intended scope or usage of a Concept — "use this for X but not Y".

urn:solid:seeAlso.label: seeAlso
urn:solid:seeAlso.description: Points at a related resource that may carry additional information about the subject — a generic "more about this here" link.

urn:solid:semanticRelation.label: semanticRelation
urn:solid:semanticRelation.description: The SKOS superproperty for any conceptual relation between Concepts — `broader`, `narrower`, `related`.

urn:solid:servesDataset.label: servesDataset
urn:solid:servesDataset.description: A Dataset that a DCAT DataService makes available.

urn:solid:serviceEndpoint.label: serviceEndpoint
urn:solid:serviceEndpoint.description: On a DID Document service entry, the URL where the service is reachable.

urn:solid:sha1.label: sha1
urn:solid:sha1.description: The SHA-1 cryptographic hash of the resource's content.

urn:solid:sharedInbox.label: sharedInbox
urn:solid:sharedInbox.description: An ActivityPub Actor-server endpoint that accepts deliveries for any local recipient — used to deduplicate fan-out when one Activity targets many followers on the same server.

urn:solid:shares.label: shares
urn:solid:shares.description: A Collection of `Announce` activities (shares / boosts / reposts) directed at an Object — discoverable from the Object itself.

urn:solid:sibling.label: sibling
urn:solid:sibling.description: A sibling of the person — sharing at least one parent.

urn:solid:someValuesFrom.label: someValuesFrom
urn:solid:someValuesFrom.description: On an OWL Restriction, asserts that at least one value of the constrained property must be an instance of a given class — an existential quantifier.

urn:solid:source.label: source
urn:solid:source.description: A related resource from which the described resource is derived.

urn:solid:spatial.label: spatial
urn:solid:spatial.description: The spatial coverage of the resource — what places it is about or applies to.

urn:solid:specializationOf.label: specializationOf
urn:solid:specializationOf.description: Asserts that one PROV Entity is a more constrained version of another — same identity, narrower aspect (e.g. a single revision of a document is a specialization of the document as a whole).

urn:solid:spouse.label: spouse
urn:solid:spouse.description: The person to whom the subject is married.

urn:solid:startTime.label: startTime
urn:solid:startTime.description: The date and time the object begins.

urn:solid:startedAtTime.label: startedAtTime
urn:solid:startedAtTime.description: The time at which the activity started.

urn:solid:status.label: status
urn:solid:status.description: A free-form status string for the agent — e.g. "online", "away", or a custom message.

urn:solid:storage.label: storage
