urn:solid:storage.description: The root of a personal data store (Solid pod) for the subject.

urn:solid:streams.label: streams
urn:solid:streams.description: Additional Collections an ActivityPub Actor exposes beyond the standard inbox/outbox/followers/following — extension points for application-specific feeds.

urn:solid:street-address.label: street-address
urn:solid:street-address.description: The street address of an Address — number, street name, unit.

urn:solid:subClassOf.label: subClassOf
urn:solid:subClassOf.description: Asserts that one class is a subclass of another — instances of the subclass are also instances of the superclass.

urn:solid:subOrganizationOf.label: subOrganizationOf
urn:solid:subOrganizationOf.description: The parent Organization that this OrganizationalUnit is part of — the inverse of `hasSubOrganization`.

urn:solid:subPropertyOf.label: subPropertyOf
urn:solid:subPropertyOf.description: Asserts that one property is a refinement of another — every triple using the subproperty also (logically) holds with the superproperty.

urn:solid:subject.label: subject
urn:solid:subject.description: A topic of the resource — typically expressed as keywords, key phrases, or controlled-vocabulary terms.

urn:solid:summary.label: summary
urn:solid:summary.description: A natural-language summary of the object — typically shorter than its `content`.

urn:solid:summaryMap.label: summaryMap
urn:solid:summaryMap.description: Language-tagged variants of an ActivityStreams Object's `summary` — keys are BCP 47 language tags, values are the localised summary strings.

urn:solid:tableOfContents.label: tableOfContents
urn:solid:tableOfContents.description: A list of subunits of the resource — chapters, sections, parts.

urn:solid:tag.label: tag
urn:solid:tag.description: An object that is part of the private secondary audience of the subject — typically a hashtag or @mention.

urn:solid:target.label: target
urn:solid:target.description: The target of the activity — the indirect object of the action.

urn:solid:telephone.label: telephone
urn:solid:telephone.description: A telephone number for the subject — typically as a plain string.

urn:solid:temporal.label: temporal
urn:solid:temporal.description: The temporal coverage of the resource — what time period it is about or applies to.

urn:solid:temporalResolution.label: temporalResolution
urn:solid:temporalResolution.description: The minimum time between samples in a DCAT Dataset or Distribution — the granularity of the time axis.

urn:solid:text.label: text
urn:solid:text.description: The textual content of the resource — used by Comments, Answers, Questions, and other text-bearing schema.org types.

urn:solid:theme.label: theme
urn:solid:theme.description: A main category of a DCAT Dataset — typically a SKOS Concept from a controlled-vocabulary theme list.

urn:solid:thumbnail.label: thumbnail
urn:solid:thumbnail.description: A thumbnail rendering of the image — a smaller version for previews.

urn:solid:to.label: to
urn:solid:to.description: The primary recipients of the object — the wire-level "send to" addresses.

urn:solid:topConceptOf.label: topConceptOf
urn:solid:topConceptOf.description: The SKOS ConceptScheme of which the Concept is a top-level entry-point — the inverse of `hasTopConcept`.

urn:solid:topic.label: topic
urn:solid:topic.description: A thing the document is about — the inverse of `page`.

urn:solid:topic_interest.label: topic_interest
urn:solid:topic_interest.description: A thing the agent is interested in — points at the resource itself, not at a page about it.

urn:solid:totalItems.label: totalItems
urn:solid:totalItems.description: The total number of members in an ActivityStreams Collection — the size the client would see if all pages were concatenated.

urn:solid:trustedApp.label: trustedApp
urn:solid:trustedApp.description: On a Solid pod owner's profile, an application origin granted broad trust — typically permitted to read or write across the pod without per-resource ACL grants.

urn:solid:type.label: type
urn:solid:type.description: Asserts that a resource is an instance of a class — the predicate behind JSON-LD's `@type` keyword.

urn:solid:unionOf.label: unionOf
urn:solid:unionOf.description: OWL class expression: defines a class as the union of a list of other classes — instances of the new class are instances of any one of the listed classes.

urn:solid:unitOf.label: unitOf
urn:solid:unitOf.description: The parent Organization that this OrganizationalUnit belongs to — inverse of `hasUnit`.

urn:solid:units.label: units
urn:solid:units.description: The unit of measurement for the linear dimensions of an ActivityStreams Place — `radius` and `altitude` are interpreted in this unit.

urn:solid:updated.label: updated
urn:solid:updated.description: The date and time the object was last updated.

urn:solid:url.label: url
urn:solid:url.description: An ActivityStreams Object's primary URL — the human-facing page where the Object can be viewed in a browser, distinct from its `@id` (the AP-facing identifier).

urn:solid:used.label: used
urn:solid:used.description: An entity used by the activity — an input or dependency that existed before the activity started.

urn:solid:valid.label: valid
urn:solid:valid.description: The date or period of validity of the resource — when it should be considered current and applicable.

urn:solid:verificationMethod.label: verificationMethod
urn:solid:verificationMethod.description: The cryptographic key (or other verification material) the verifier should use to check a proof — typically a fragment of a DID Document.

urn:solid:version.label: version
urn:solid:version.description: The version designation of the resource — typically a string like "2.0" or "v3.1.4".

urn:solid:wasAssociatedWith.label: wasAssociatedWith
urn:solid:wasAssociatedWith.description: An agent that had a role or responsibility in the activity — performed it, oversaw it, or was implicated in it.

urn:solid:wasAttributedTo.label: wasAttributedTo
urn:solid:wasAttributedTo.description: An agent to which the entity is attributed — without claiming the agent performed any specific action.

urn:solid:wasDerivedFrom.label: wasDerivedFrom
urn:solid:wasDerivedFrom.description: An entity from which the subject entity was derived — a precursor or input.

urn:solid:wasEndedBy.label: wasEndedBy
urn:solid:wasEndedBy.description: An Entity that ended a PROV Activity — the signal, completion event, or termination input that caused the Activity to stop.

urn:solid:wasGeneratedBy.label: wasGeneratedBy
urn:solid:wasGeneratedBy.description: The PROV activity that generated the entity — the production event responsible for its existence.

urn:solid:wasInfluencedBy.label: wasInfluencedBy
urn:solid:wasInfluencedBy.description: The most general PROV influence relation — asserts that one Entity, Activity, or Agent had some effect on another, without specifying the kind of influence.

urn:solid:wasInformedBy.label: wasInformedBy
urn:solid:wasInformedBy.description: An activity exchanged information with the prior activity — without naming the entity that flowed between them.

urn:solid:wasInvalidatedBy.label: wasInvalidatedBy
urn:solid:wasInvalidatedBy.description: The PROV Activity that invalidated (deleted, retracted, expired) the Entity.

urn:solid:wasQuotedFrom.label: wasQuotedFrom
urn:solid:wasQuotedFrom.description: An Entity is a quotation, excerpt, or reproduction of part of another Entity — the source remains identifiable and authoritative.

urn:solid:wasRevisionOf.label: wasRevisionOf
urn:solid:wasRevisionOf.description: An Entity that this Entity is a revision of — same nominal identity, updated content (a v2 of a document, a re-issued dataset).

urn:solid:wasStartedBy.label: wasStartedBy
urn:solid:wasStartedBy.description: An Entity that started a PROV Activity — the trigger or input whose existence caused the Activity to begin.

urn:solid:weblog.label: weblog
urn:solid:weblog.description: A weblog (blog) of the subject — the document the agent publishes posts to.

urn:solid:width.label: width
urn:solid:width.description: The width in pixels of an ActivityStreams Object — typically an Image, Video, or Link to a visual resource.

urn:solid:workplaceHomepage.label: workplaceHomepage
urn:solid:workplaceHomepage.description: A homepage of an organization the person works for.

urn:solid:worksFor.label: worksFor
urn:solid:worksFor.description: An organization the person currently works for.
